title: Latihan 1: Ekstraksi Informasi Dimensi dan Rasio Aspek Citra
instruction: Tuliskan fungsi Python bernama `analyze_multimedia_tensor(array, media_type)` yang menerima array NumPy dan tipe media ('image_gray', 'image_color', 'audio', 'video'). Fungsi harus mengembalikan dictionary berisi informasi dimensi, jumlah elemen, tipe data, dan ukuran memori dalam kilobytes (KB).
starterCode:
import numpy as np

def analyze_multimedia_tensor(array: np.ndarray, media_type: str) -> dict:
    # TODO: Lengkapi ekstraksi metadata
    pass
solution:
import numpy as np

def analyze_multimedia_tensor(array: np.ndarray, media_type: str) -> dict:
    info = {
        'media_type': media_type,
        'shape': array.shape,
        'ndim': array.ndim,
        'dtype': str(array.dtype),
        'total_elements': array.size,
        'memory_kb': round(array.nbytes / 1024, 2)
    }
    if media_type == 'image_color' and array.ndim == 3:
        h, w, c = array.shape
        info['aspect_ratio'] = round(w / h, 2)
    return info

title: Latihan 2: Pembuatan Pola Sintetis Multi-Kanal (Synthetic Test Pattern)

solution:
import numpy as np

def create_quadrant_pattern() -> np.ndarray:
    img = np.zeros((200, 200, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
    # Kiri-atas: Merah (R=255, G=0, B=0)
    img[:100, :100, 0] = 255
    # Kanan-atas: Hijau (R=0, G=255, B=0)
    img[:100, 100:, 1] = 255
    # Kiri-bawah: Biru (R=0, G=0, B=255)
    img[100:, :100, 2] = 255
    # Kanan-bawah: Putih (R=255, G=255, B=255)
    img[100:, 100:, :] = 255
    return img
